Chapter Analysis — NEET 2027 is chapter ko kaise use karta hai

💻 Update 1: NEET UG 2027 = CBT (Computer Based Test) mode

  • 15 May 2026 — Union Education Minister (Dharmendra Pradhan) ne announce kiya: NEET-UG 2026 ke paper leak ke baad, 2027 se NEET computer-based test (CBT) mode mein hoga. Root cause OMR-based exam bataya gaya.
  • 29–30 May 2026 — NTA ne Supreme Court ko affidavit diya: High Level Committee of Experts (HLCE) ne PPT (pen-paper) se CBT shift + multi-session/multi-stage testing recommend kiya hai; NTA CBT conduct karne ke liye "all set" hai.
  • Sept–Oct 2026 — SC ko bataya gaya ki CBT shift "active consideration" mein hai (Nandan Nilekani task force ki report pending); NTA ne CBT centres ke liye AICTE ko letter likha; ≈1000 centres par 5–6 din mein ≈5 lakh candidates/day capacity ka plan. NTA DG ne bhi 14 Sept 2026 ko CBT transition confirm kiya.
Tumhare liye matlab: CBT mein rough sheet aur OMR marking ka time bachega, lekin calculation speed hi asli game hai. NTA ke CBT exams (JEE/NET) mein numerical, graph-based aur multi-step questions ka weight badh jata hai. Isi liye ye mock test 100 Q / 100 min (1 min per question) rakha hai — bilkul NEET ke CBT-style pace.

📌 Update 2: "Basic Maths & Calculus" NEET syllabus mein chapter nahi — ye poore paper ki speed aur accuracy ka engine hai

  • NEET 2026 (Code 11, Aakash analysis): Physics Tough tha, 26–28 questions numerical the, sabse time-consuming section. Candidates 5–8 questions sirf time ki kami se chhod dete the. Physics ab lagatar 5 saal (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) sabse tough section raha hai.
  • Physics ka expected average score 85–115/180 hota hai — isi section mein 30–40 marks ka swing aata hai. 99.5+ percentile chahiye to Physics hi decisive hai.
  • Chapters jinme is chapter ke tools direct hit karte hain: Kinematics (graph + variable acceleration), Laws of Motion (vector resolution), Work–Energy , Rotational , Electrostatics, Magnetism , EMI , Current Electricity (– slope), Ray Optics (lens formula approximations), Modern Physics (decay logs).
  • Har saal kam se kam 5–8 questions aise hote hain jahan question kisi aur chapter ka hota hai, par solve sirf isi chapter ke tools se hota hai — 1 minute ke andar.

PYQ 2 — JEE Mains 2007 (NEET 2027 ke CBT-avatar ka hint):
"The velocity of a particle is . If its position is at , then its displacement after unit time is:"

Answer: .

Pattern sum-up: NEET ka "Basic Maths" question kabhi directly aata hai (2006 jaisa calculus–kinematics mix), aur kabhi indirectly har numerical question ke andar. NEET 2026 mein numericals badh gaye the — iska seedha matlab: ye chapter strong nahi hai to Physics 100/180 par atak jayega.

TargetMarks (720 mein)Section-wise
(top medical colleges)≈700–715Physics ≈170–180 · Chemistry ≈175–180 · Biology ≈350–360
Chapter-1 (Basic Maths) ka targetIss test mein = "chapter mastery" (95%+ accuracy, 1 min/question)
Tumhara currentGap = concept speed + numerical practice. Isi liye ye test easy se elite tak graded hai.

Is mock ka design: har section mein 20 questions, jo 🟢 Easy → 🟡 Moderate → 🟠 Hard → 🔴 Elite (JEE-Mains level) tak jaate hain. Sabhi questions 4 options wale MCQ hain, NEET pattern (+4 / −1), aur poori range of concepts cover ki gayi hai — basic exponents se lekar aur distance-vs-displacement traps tak.

🖱️ Ye test ab interactive hai (CBT jaisa): kisi bhi option par click karo — turant batayega ✅ sahi ya ❌ galat, aur neeche detailed explanation khul jayega (concept + step-by-step + trap + memory hook). Top ki score bar aapka live score rakhegi (+4 / −1). "Solution dekho" button se bina attempt kiye bhi explanation padh sakte ho.

📈 Figures/graphs: jin 27 questions ko graph ya diagram ki zaroorat thi (velocity–time graph, log–log plot, vector resolution, projectile curve, circle ka etc.), un sabke saath printed-textbook style figure bhi diya gaya hai — bilkul NEET ke asli paper jaisa. Ye sab question ki phrasing ko badle bina add kiye gaye hain.

📝 Test Instructions (CBT-mode simulate karo)

  • Ek hi sitting mein 100 minute ka timer laga kar do. Beech mein pause = test waste. Rough sheet (kaagaz-pen) use kar sakte ho.
  • Marking: +4 sahi, −1 galat, 0 chhoda. 100 questions = 400 marks. App khud score bar mein live hisaab rakhta hai (Reset button se dobara shuru).
  • Answer karne ka tarika: option par click karte hi wahi question lock ho jayega (CBT jaisa) — phir explanation khud khul jayega. Isliye click karne se pehle apna final answer decide karo.
  • Speed target: Section A–C ≈30 second/question, Section D ≈45 second, Section E ≈60–90 second. Jo question atke use skip karke aage badho — yahi NEET ka CBT strategy hai.
  • Graph-based questions mein pehle figure 5 second dekho (axis labels, slope ya area) — zyadatar jawab figure se hi nikal aata hai; phir hi calculation shuru karo.
  • Test ke baad: Error Log table bharo aur neeche Concept Revision Sheet ek baar padh lo. Har galat question ki explanation dobara padhna — wahi tumhara real syllabus hai.
🟢 Easy 🟡 Moderate (asli NEET level) 🟠 Hard (NEET tough) 🔴 Elite (JEE-Mains / rank-50 killer)

CBT ke liye 3 habits (2027 ke liye aaj se): (1) Har question ka answer man mein solve karke click karo, kaagaz par likhne ki aadat kam karo. (2) Ruler/pen se OMR ki tarah circle mat banao — screen par sirf click. (3) Timer hamesha on-screen — practice mein bhi 1 min/question ka pace dohrao.
